notes: Temporal-validity probe: every fact in the ledger is qualified by dates, and all classification is evaluated against a fixed reference date read from the audit file. The agent must (1) replay amendments onto base fields with latest-effective_on<=as_of wins (later-list-position tie-break), value-null clears the field, non-amendable/malformed amendments ignored; (2) classify charters with mixed inclusive/exclusive boundary semantics (end_on inclusive, terminated_on exclusive, start_on as-of-amended, signed_on existence check) into active/pending/excluded; (3) count malformed lines; (4) emit exactly-sorted ids and vessel aggregates. Hard: the amendment replay plus asymmetric boundary rules is easy to get subtly wrong, and the verifier re-runs the deliverable on hidden ledgers with different as-of dates, amendment patterns (retro-active, future, clearing, double amendments) and junk lines, so an incomplete date predicate keeps outdated facts in the results and fails.
